children: Enjoy $5 General Admission Movie Tickets and $5 Small Bags of Popcorn on September 5 and 6 while supporting Canadian Picture Pioneers
– Cineplex’s $5 Weekend returns September 5 and 6, giving Canadians the perfect opportunity to discover new films, try a new experience and fit more movie moments into one weekend, for less.

With general admission movie tickets and small bags of popcorn priced at just $5 each, plus tax (in-theatre price), this is the ideal weekend to catch up on summer blockbusters, create a movie marathon or enjoy an outing with the whole family before settling back into school year routines.

It’s also a great time to explore the many different ways to see a movie by upgrading to a premium experience, available for an additional fee. Whether it’s the stunning picture quality and dynamic sound of UltraAVX or the elevated menu, signature cocktails and in-seat service offered in VIP Cinemas, Cineplex offers something for every movie lover. Additional formats including IMAX, D-BOX, 4DX, ScreenX, RealD 3D and Clubhouse make it easy to enjoy a memorable night at the movies for less this weekend.
The impact of $5 Weekend goes beyond the big screen. A portion of proceeds will be donated to the
), a charitable organization dedicated to supporting members of Canada’s motion picture industry through financial assistance and educational programs since 1940.

Five dollar general admission tickets are available at the theatre and online general admission ticket are priced up to $6.50 each, plus tax, which includes an online booking fee of up to $1.50. This offer is not valid for 70MM performances (including IMAX 70MM), non-feature films or Cineplex Events performances.
For more information on $5 Weekend and to purchase general admission tickets, visit
. General admission tickets go on sale Wednesday, September 2.

$5 Weekend is just one of many ways Cineplex helps guests enjoy entertainment for less. To learn more about additional promotions, rewards, and exclusive offers, visit Cineplex.com/Deals. Make sure to follow Cineplex on Instagram (@cineplexmovies), X (@cineplexmovies) and Facebook (@Cineplex) for updates on movies, programming and events.

is a top-tier Canadian brand that operates in the Film Entertainment and Content, Amusement and Leisure, and Media sectors. Cineplex offers a unique escape from the everyday to millions of guests through its circuit of 169 movie theatres and location-based entertainment venues. In addition to being Canada’s largest and most innovative film exhibitor, the company operates Canada’s favourite destination for ‘Eats & Entertainment’ (The Rec Room), complexes specially designed for teens and families (Playdium), and an entertainment concept that brings movies, amusement gaming, dining, and live performances together under one roof (Cineplex Junxion). It also operates successful businesses in cinema media (Cineplex Media), alternative programming (Cineplex Events) and motion picture distribution (Cineplex Pictures). Providing even more value for its guests, Cineplex is a partner in Scene+, Canada’s largest entertainment and lifestyle loyalty program.
Proudly recognized as having one of the country's Most Admired Corporate Cultures, Cineplex employs over 10,000 people in its offices and venues across Canada. To learn more, visit Cineplex.com.
